title: sericocalyx quadrifarius
intro: Sericocalyx quadrifarius, commonly known as the Four-angled Serico, is a flowering plant species in the family Lamiaceae. The health benefits of Sericocalyx quadrifarius include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate expectoration, relieve bronchial spasms, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Sericocalyx quadrifarius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
